description:
The Cancer iChart Archive app is open on the Welcome screen. Your task has two parts:

Part 1 - View Disclaimer:
1. On the Welcome screen, tap the 'Disclaimer' button.
2. Read the disclaimer content.
3. Close/navigate back to the Welcome screen.

Part 2 - Perform an interaction check:
4. Tap 'Search For Drug Interactions'.
5. Select 'Dabrafenib' as the cancer drug (use A-Z index to jump to 'D').
6. Tap 'Next' to go to Co-medications.
7. Select 'Carbamazepine' as the co-medication (use A-Z index to jump to 'C').
8. Tap 'Next' to view the Results.
9. Tap the arrow on the result card to view Interaction Details.
10. Verify you are on the Interaction Details page showing the Dabrafenib + Carbamazepine interaction details.
